items.difficulty_reason: The counted conclusion is the two perfectness-and-base-change assertions for M = RGamma(X, K tensor E) and N = RHom_X(E, K) at source lines 2404-2422, label lemma-compute-against-perfect, whose proof occupies source lines 2424-2452. The proof is not a bare citation chain: it sets up the stages N_n, derives their base change compatible perfectness, produces the limit object N = R lim N_n with recovery isomorphisms, and carries out the commutation argument that RHom_X(E, -) commutes with products and hence with derived limits, chaining it against the definition of K as the derived limit; part one is then obtained by an explicit duality translation. The counted statement records none of this: neither the stage-wise setup nor the limit commutation nor the duality reduction appears in it.
